calculation.description: Ranks assets by their lagged 20-session loss normalized by 60-session downside volatility, activating only when the cross-asset fraction with negative 20-session returns is elevated. Larger values indicate more oversold, downside-efficient candidates for rebound. All inputs are shifted one completed session before use.

validation.regime_notes: Negative in 2020-2023 (-0.01529 at 40D), positive thereafter: 2024-2026 +0.04298, 2027-2029 +0.15160, 2030-2032 +0.06756, 2033-2034 +0.07197. Interpret early-regime weakness conservatively; recent robustness is favorable.
validation.admission: Passes benchmark absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840 at 60-session horizon.
